options.content: **Data since ${go_live}.** There is no backfill: charts start empty at go-live and fill as the collector runs. All times are UTC.

panels.title: Monday event attendance (0700-1200Z)
panels.description: v1 card 131. Distinct pilot CIDs and distinct controller CIDs present at any time between 0700 and 1200 UTC on each Monday (sessions overlapping the window). Window changed from v1 (0800-1200) to 0700-1200 per the specification.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT win_start AS time, pilot_cids AS "Pilots", controller_cids AS "Controllers"
FROM monday_attendance
WHERE win_start BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
ORDER BY win_start

panels.title: Share of YMML-YSSY airborne time flown by local pilots (Mondays 0700-1200Z)
panels.description: v1 card 134 ('What percentage of MRM traffic were locals?'). Per week, the share of airborne minutes on YMML-YSSY and YSSY-YMML flights ending between 0700 and 1200 UTC on Monday that were flown by pilots whose home airfield is in the home region. Changed from v1: airborne minutes instead of time online, home prefixes from settings rather than a hard-coded Y, and a 0700 start.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (date_trunc('week', f.end_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS time,
       round(100.0 * COALESCE(sum(f.airborne_minutes) FILTER (WHERE f.pilot_is_local), 0)
             / NULLIF(sum(f.airborne_minutes), 0), 1) AS "Local pilots (%)"
FROM flight_ext f
WHERE f.end_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND extract(isodow FROM f.end_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') = 1
  AND (f.end_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::time >= time '07:00'
  AND (f.end_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::time < time '12:00'
  AND ((f.departure = 'YMML' AND f.arrival = 'YSSY') OR (f.departure = 'YSSY' AND f.arrival = 'YMML'))
  AND f.airborne_minutes > 0
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Airborne aircraft during the latest Monday event (0700-1200Z, 5-minute slots)
panels.description: v1 card 156 ('Number of airborne acft during last Mondays event?', edited 06-10-2025). Distinct pilot sessions with a position above 1000 ft in each 5-minute slot between 0700Z and 1200Z (UTC) on the most recent Monday whose 0700Z start has passed (today from 0700Z if it is Monday, otherwise the Monday before; corrected, issue 94); slots still in the future are not drawn. Changed from v1: v1 counted from its sector-occupancy table; v3 counts the raw 15-second positions directly, so no sector logic is used (ADR-002). A slot counts a session if any sample falls inside the 5 minutes starting at the slot. Positions are kept 90 days, so only recent Mondays can be shown.

targets.rawSql:
WITH mon AS (
  -- The most recent Monday whose 0700Z start has passed: 7 hours back from now, so Monday 00:00 to 06:59Z still shows last Monday
  SELECT (date_trunc('day', (now() - interval '7 hours') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')
          - (extract(isodow FROM (now() - interval '7 hours') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int - 1) * interval '1 day') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS d
),
slots AS (
  SELECT mon.d + interval '7 hours' + n * interval '5 minutes' AS slot
  FROM mon CROSS JOIN generate_series(0, 59) AS n
),
samples AS (
  SELECT s.observed_at, s.session_id
  FROM pilot_sample s
  WHERE s.observed_at >= (SELECT d FROM mon) + interval '7 hours'
    AND s.observed_at <  (SELECT d FROM mon) + interval '12 hours'
    AND s.alt_ft > 1000
)
SELECT sl.slot AS time,
       count(DISTINCT sa.session_id) AS "Airborne aircraft"
FROM slots sl
LEFT JOIN samples sa
       ON sa.observed_at >= sl.slot AND sa.observed_at < sl.slot + interval '5 minutes'
WHERE sl.slot <= now()
GROUP BY sl.slot
ORDER BY sl.slot
